title: DojoLiq Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: For those who enjoy a contrasting profile, Vaporesso DojoLiq Blueberry Sour Raspberry delivers a bold sweet-and-sour mix. The inhale offers the deep, jammy sweetness of Blueberries, providing a rich foundation. This is instantly countered by a sharp, tangy Raspberry note on the exhale that adds a mouth-watering sour kick, keeping the flavour dynamic and highly vibrant. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 43% VG / 57% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Available in 5mg,10mg and 20mg strengths Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. These e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
